findings.title: jsPDF Local File Inclusion / Path Traversal (affected range <=3.0.4)
findings.description: Installed jspdf ^2.5.1 falls in the vulnerable range; browser-only bundle lowers practical exposure because the Node filesystem path is not shipped.
findings.remediation: Upgrade jspdf to a patched major (>=4.2.1); requires API migration of the reports PDF export, deliberately deferred from this UI/UX increment.

findings.title: jsPDF HTML Injection in New Window paths (affected range <=4.2.0)
findings.description: Same dependency chain; HTML-to-PDF rendering of untrusted markup could inject. The app converts only fixed internal report markup.
findings.remediation: Covered by the same jspdf upgrade follow-up.
